test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In which state was the Indo-Dutch centre of excellence (CoE) for vegetables and flowers opened in November 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **An Indo-Dutch centre of excellence (CoE) for vegetables and flowers has been opened in Kerala's Wayanad district.**
 
• **A tissue culture laboratory has been set up as part of the project for producing good quality planting materials.**
 
• The** centre will also explore possibilities in Agri-Horti tourism in the district**.
 
• **The idea is to transform Wayanad into a hub of floriculture.**
 
• The **CoE will be based in the Regional Agricultural Research Station of the Kerala Agricultural University at Ambalavayal **in Wayanad District, Kerala. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• **Chief Minister of Kerala:** Kerala Pinarayi Vijayan.
 
• **Governor of Kerala:** Arif Mohammad Khan.
 
• **Union Minister for Agriculture & Farmers’ Welfare: **Narendra Singh Tomar (as of June 2022).
